_comment: What a custom operator needs that the library cannot derive: its own
human-readable expression, and the fields it reads. Maintained beside the
Rego that defines the operator — examples/control_43_ops.rego — because
an op is a reusable library extension, not part of any one policy.
`phrase` is the prose that selects it, after any leading quantifier.
`inputs` entries are either a path relative to the subject, or a
projection through the property the rule names.
This is the one place a step-like translation layer returns: one entry
per operator, not one per sentence.

identities_resolved.expression: some pull_request: (every commit: author_username resolves or author is web-flow) or (every approver: username resolves)

independently_approved.expression: some pull_request: every author: some approver != author where state == APPROVED and timestamp > max(commits[].timestamp)
